1725	
1726	// compactHeadViewLocked writes a block (or sequence of blocks, one per chunk range) for the
1727	// restricted head view produced by viewFactory, then runs evictor to remove those series from the
1728	// head. HeadMinTime is not advanced; series outside the view are unaffected. configure, if
1729	// non-nil, is called on the freshly created BlockMeta before each write to set compaction hints
1730	// or other optional fields.
1731	// The caller must hold db.cmtx.
1732	func (db *DB) compactHeadViewLocked(viewFactory headViewFactory, evict headSeriesEvictor, configure func(*BlockMeta)) error {
1733		mint, maxt := db.head.opts.ChunkRange*(db.head.MinTime()/db.head.opts.ChunkRange), db.head.MaxTime()
1734		// Capture the head's current append-ID as an eviction watermark before
1735		// writing any blocks.
1736		//
1737		// The generated blocks are guaranteed to contain all samples with
1738		// appendID <= watermark. Samples appended later (appendID > watermark)
1739		// may or may not be present, depending on when each block writer takes
1740		// its isolation snapshot.
1741		//
1742		// Eviction uses the watermark as a safety guard: a series is removed
1743		// only if it has not received any samples with appendID > watermark
1744		// since compaction began.
1745		appendIDWatermark := db.head.iso.lastAppendID()
1746		// The bound is inclusive so that a sample sitting exactly on a chunk-range boundary
1747		// (mint == maxt) still gets a block written before its series is evicted.
1748		for ; mint <= maxt; mint += db.head.chunkRange.Load() {
1749			view := viewFactory(db.head, mint, mint+db.head.chunkRange.Load()-1)
1750	
1751			meta := &BlockMeta{}

1754			}

1758			}

1760			// compactor.Write returns no UIDs when the view contained no chunks, which happens

units.headline: Extract s.ooo == nil check into isSeriesWithoutOOO helper
units.summary: Moves the existing `s.ooo != nil` skip check out of the stale-series filter into a named predicate. It is now also used by CompactSelectedSeries and the eviction predicates. It behaves the same as the inline check it replaces.
units.reason: Same check as the removed inline code; the new callers are reviewed in their own units.

units.headline: Extract stale-NaN last-value check into isStaleSeries helper
units.summary: The stale-marker check used to be duplicated in gcStaleSeries and staleSeriesRefsNoOOOData. It is now one helper, with the same three conditions (float, histogram and float-histogram Sum) as the removed code.
units.reason: Same expression as the removed duplicated code.

units.headline: Stale-series eviction now also needs no appendID above watermark
units.summary: truncateStaleSeries now takes an appendIDWatermark and evicts a series only if it has no OOO data, is still stale, and has no in-memory sample committed after the watermark. This changes which series CompactStaleHead evicts, and the signature change affects every caller.
focus: Watermark is captured before any block write (compactHeadViewLocked takes iso.lastAppendID first)
Stale series that get a late commit stay in the head and are not double-counted in numStaleSeries
Tests pass math.MaxUint64, which turns the guard off; check that this does not hide regressions
units.reason: Changes the eviction predicate of an existing compaction path that deletes series and writes WAL tombstones.

units.headline: New eviction path for caller-selected series with OOO/watermark guard
units.summary: Adds an eviction routine for CompactSelectedSeries. It removes series that have no OOO data, no maxTime beyond maxt, and no append above the watermark. Evicted series are tombstoned in the WAL, so evicting the wrong series loses data permanently.
focus: With isolation disabled the watermark guard does nothing, so late in-range appends are lost (the test confirms this)
OOO data that arrives between filtering and eviction is caught here by isSeriesWithoutOOO
units.reason: New code path that permanently deletes series data from the head and the WAL.

units.headline: New appendID ring scan to detect commits after compaction watermark
units.summary: Walks the series' txRing, txIDCount entries from txIDFirst, and reports true if any appendID is above the watermark. It returns false when isolation is disabled (txs nil). This is the main guard against losing samples that arrive during compaction.
focus: The ring keeps the newest appendID: cleanupAppendIDsBelow only drops IDs below the low watermark, which stays at or below the latest append
Callers hold s.Lock: gcSeries calls it through iterForDeletion
units.reason: Correctness guard that decides whether eviction loses data under concurrent writes.

units.headline: Generalize stale truncation into predicate-driven truncateSeries returning count
units.summary: The former truncateStaleSeries body becomes a generic truncateSeries that takes a shouldEvict predicate, calls gcSeries, records tombstones for the deleted refs, and returns how many series were evicted. Locking, the reader wait and WAL logging are unchanged.
focus: Tombstones are written only for refs actually deleted (unchanged)
The new return value is ignored by both wrappers
units.reason: Core eviction routine is restructured around a caller-supplied predicate that controls data deletion.

units.headline: Test call updated to new truncateStaleSeries signature
units.summary: Passes math.MaxUint64 as the watermark, which keeps the old behavior. The assertions are unchanged.
